SASBDB entry SASDUN5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDUN5/)

Publication: Deciphering the allosteric regulation of mycobacterial inosine-5'-monophosphate dehydrogenase
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-50933-6

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDUN5/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
